measure.$description: Role: maximum line length of the page column.

popup.$description: Role: width of a browser extension popup.

padding-x.$description: Role: horizontal page padding below the md breakpoint.

padding-x-md.$description: Role: horizontal page padding from the md breakpoint.

padding-y.$description: Role: vertical page padding below the md breakpoint.

padding-y-md.$description: Role: vertical page padding from the md breakpoint.

label.$description: Role: text size of labels on command and key blocks.

chip.$description: Role: text size of chips and error notices.

meta.$description: Role: text size of navigation, footer and contact links.

caption.$description: Role: text size of page captions and header details.

note.$description: Role: text size of notes and history entries.

small.$description: Role: text size of fact lists and status lines.

body.$description: Role: text size of long-form prose.

lead.$description: Role: text size of section headings.

title.$description: Role: text size of page titles and status headings.

display.$description: Role: text size of the top-level heading.
Role: line height of the top-level heading.

block.$description: Role: line height of command blocks and intro text.

mono.$description: Role: line height of monospace blocks.

prose.$description: Role: line height of long-form prose.
